title: Wikimedia data for AI: a review of Wikimedia datasets for NLP tasks and AI-assisted editing

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing benchmarks that evaluate a model's ability to identify and remove subjective or biased language from sentences based on Wikipedia's editorial policies.

Reviewing benchmarks (e.g., WikiContradict) that assess whether models can fairly represent all reliable sources and summarize contradictory information without giving undue weight to fringe theories.
Cataloging the language coverage of existing NLP datasets and tasks to highlight the disproportionate focus on English and the systemic underrepresentation of other Wikipedia languages.
